explanation: A divine messenger holding a small scroll and standing with one foot on the sea and the other on the land.
A written document containing God's word or prophecy, here described as open for reading but tasting bitter in the stomach.
A series of divine expressions or judgments whose content is not to be revealed until the appointed time.
A holy pledge given by the Almighty who created heaven and earth that there will no longer be any delay.
A period of historical significance in which God's plans are fulfilled, marked by the end of waiting.
A taste sensation symbolizing the difficult and sorrowful messages contained in prophecy.
A contrasting taste sensation representing God's grace, truth, or salvation for those who believe.
